provenance.notes: The Mercedes-AMG GT4 has been part of the Customer Racing range since 2018, its first racing season; it is still offered, with later development stages of the same car.

provenance.source: RACER, Mercedes-AMG unveils its GT4 (25 July 2017)
provenance.notes: Presented at the 2017 Spa-Francorchamps 24 Hours, based on the Mercedes-AMG GT R, with deliveries to customer teams from the end of 2017: start of the generation.

provenance.source: Wikidata: Mercedes-AMG (Q26966), Mercedes-AMG GT (Q18011551), Mercedes-AMG GT4 (Q44954373)
provenance.notes: External ids of the make and the model; the GT4 has its own item, not linked here. The GT4 is based on the first generation of the Mercedes-AMG GT (the GT R); no public chassis code is recorded here, so the generation has a neutral id.
